headline: Gold Prices Hit 12-Month Low Amid Federal Reserve Rate Hike Expectations
summary: Gold closed Friday at its lowest level in 12 months as stock market losses and expectations of December Federal Reserve rate hikes forced investors to sell bullion.
why: Gold is traditionally viewed as a safe-haven asset and an inflation hedge. Rising interest rates increase the opportunity cost of holding non-yielding bullion, typically strengthening the US dollar and pressuring gold prices.
